title: Copper mining in the north: Chuquicamata and Escondida
goal: Describe how copper is mined and processed in northern Chile, using the passive with se.
grammar: passive with se (known), applied to copper mining

items: I can describe how copper is obtained with the passive *se* (*se tritura la roca*, *se construyen plantas*).
I can say why copper matters in the history and the economy of Chile.
I can use the new words for mines, ore and copper processing.
